display_long_description:
Virtual medical simulation education for healthcare professionals, medical and nursing students.

Medicrew (formal “Nursebase”, formal “Medibase”) provides virtual medical education service that enables various clinical practices in a mobile platform. Six virtual cases are developed based on real evidence and medical advice from 33 medical professionals and these cases are applicable in hospital and educational settings.

Improve clinical performance! Improve clinical reasoning ability! Improve critical thinking skills! Effective medical/nursing education is possible with virtual clinical practice!

You can receive high-quality medical education regardless of country or region. It is possible to practice various cases efficiently and repeatedly at a lower cost and in a shorter time. Realistic practice is possible based on actual patient data such as stethoscope sound, biofeedback, and pupil response.
